https://thenewbev.com/program/august-1-d.description: In a hyper-violent dystopic metropolis, an elite law enforcement group acts as judge, jury, and executioner. And when veteran officer Judge Dredd (Karl Urban) and his young recruit (Olivia Thirlby) arrive at a 200-storey tower block to investigate a murder, they’ll find themselves in a ruthless battle with a vicious drug kingpin (Lena Headey) and her seemingly endless army of killers. Screenwriter Alex Garland adapts the legendary comic.

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-1-t.description: Danny DeVito and Billy Crystal star in a black comedy riff on Hitchcock’s Strangers on a Train ! Crystal plays a newly divorced sad sack bitter that his ex-wife stole his novel and turned it into her own bestseller. DeVito is the long-suffering momma’s boy eager to get out from his mother’s thumb. But when one suggests trading murders as the perfect alibi, the foul play will spin hilariously out of control. DeVito directs his first theatrical feature film, while director of photography Barry Sonnenfeld adds a stylish & energetic verve to the proceedings (the same year he also helmed Raising Arizona ). Plus, Anne Ramsey is unforgettable as DeVito’s domineering mother.

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-1-w.description: An animated coming of age classic from the beloved Studio Ghibli, featuring a funny, heartfelt screenplay by Hayao Miyazaki based on the original manga by Aoi Hiiragi. When a quiet, creative girl with dreams of becoming a writer looks carefully through her library books, she discovers they were all checked out previously by the same person, leading her on a life-changing quest that unlocks her talent & potential. Take Me Home, Country Roads.

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-10-.description: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results. (The Horror Section)

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-11-.description: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results. (The Horror Section)

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-12-.description: In this captivating and philosophical film directed by Louis Malle, actor and playwright Wallace Shawn sits down with his friend the theater director André Gregory at a restaurant on New York’s Upper West Side, and the pair proceed through an alternately whimsical and despairing confessional about love, death, money, and all the superstition in between. Playing variations on their own New York–honed personas, Shawn and Gregory, who also cowrote the screenplay, dive in with introspective intellectual gusto, and Malle captures it all with a delicate, artful detachment. A fascinating freeze-frame of cosmopolitan culture, My Dinner with André remains a unique work in cinema history. (Janus Films)

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-14-.description: Winner of 8 Academy Awards, including Best Actress and Best Director, director / choreographer Bob Fosse’s adaptation of the Broadway show is a stylish, big screen musical masterpiece. Set in 1931 Berlin, Cabaret chronicles young American Sally Bowles (Liza Minnelli) and her bohemian life as a performer at the Kit Kat Klub during the last days of the Weimar Republic, as well as her relationships with a reserved academic (Michael York) and a rich playboy (Helmut Griem). Minnelli is electric in her star-making role and a stellar Joel Grey shines in his Best Supporting Actor performance as the bawdy Master of Ceremonies.

All the glory and splendor of King Arthur’s court presented in massive CinemaScope! The Arthurian legend receives a lavish Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer adaptation, lusciously lensed by Freddie Young ( Lawrence of Arabia ) & Stephen Dade ( Zulu ), and featuring a stirring Miklos Rozsa score. Sir Lancelot (Robert Taylor) is sworn to serve King Arthur (Mel Ferrer), but his devotion to the queen (Ava Gardner) could provide fuel for their enemies to destroy Camelot.

The cult Canadian show makes the giant leap to the big screen with this wildly ambitious & riotously funny instant-classic that demands to be seen with an audience. When their elaborate plans to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, a pair of best buds (Matt Johnson & Jay McCarrol) accidentally get sent back in time to the year 2008.

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-16-.description: A groundbreaking underwater adventure based on the timeless Jules Verne tale! When a vessel investigating a monster terrorizing the seas is attacked, they’ll discover Captain Nemo and his fantastic submarine, the Nautilus. But the danger & mysteries deepen as Nemo’s backstory comes into focus.

Liz Renay ( Desperate Living ), Steckler regular Carolyn Brandt, legendary stuntman Gary Kent, and Steckler himself (under his Cash Flagg alias) star.

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-20-.description: Oakland A’s general manager Billy Beane (Brad Pitt) challenges the system and defies conventional wisdom when he is forced to rebuild his small-market team, on a limited budget. Despite opposition from the old guard, the media, fans and their own manager (Philip Seymour Hoffman), Beane – with the help of a young, number-crunching, Yale-educated economist (Jonah Hill) – develops a roster of misfits… and along the way, forever changes the way the game is played. (Sony Pictures)

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-22-.description: Documentary filmmaker Terry Zwigoff’s first fictional feature is a bitingly funny adaptation of Daniel Clowes’ famed underground comic. A sardonic Thora Birch and a young Scarlett Johansson are quintessential teenage outsiders adrift in post-high school ennui. But crossing paths with kindred spirit Seymour (Steve Buscemi) will change their friendship forever. Filled with a dream team supporting cast, Ghost World creates specific, believable people and all-too-relatable cringe-inducing laughs.

The sands will rise. The heavens will part. The power will be unleashed. Brendan Fraser & Rachel Weisz star in a rollicking, thrill-a-minute adventure that’s one of the most entertaining blockbusters of the ‘90s. When an American adventurer (Fraser) teams with an Egyptologist librarian (Weisz) and her brother (John Hannah) to uncover the lost City of the Dead, they’ll discover that disturbing the slumber of an ancient priest doomed for eternity could destroy the world.

H.G. Wells’ most famous and fantastic story rockets across the screen in one of the most celebrated science fiction films of all time! When a mysterious object lands in a small Southern California town, a Martian invasion unleashes a mighty panorama of earth-shaking fury. Genre icon producer George Pal presents a classic terror tale for the atomic age, a thrill-a-minute stunner featuring Oscar-winning visual effects, iconic leads in Gene Barry and Ann Robinson, a stellar Leith Stevens score, and costuming by Edith Head.

A heart-racing spy story by Alfred Hitchcock, The 39 Steps follows Richard Hannay (Robert Donat) as he stumbles upon a conspiracy that thrusts him into a hectic chase across the Scottish moors – a chase in which he is both the pursuer and the pursued – as well as into an unexpected romance with the cool Pamela (Madeline Carroll). This classic wrong-man thriller from the Master of Suspense anticipates the director’s most famous works (especially North by Northwest ), and remains one of his cleverest and most entertaining films. (American Genre Film Archive)

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-29-.description: Canadian slackers Bob & Doug McKenzie (Rick Moranis & Dave Thomas) will do anything to keep the suds flowing. But when they land a gig at Elsinore Brewing and discover a diabolical scheme to take over the world, they’ll have to stop the evil Brewmeister Smith (Max von Sydow) and his hockey-playing hellions in this SCTV cult classic.

He never misses his target, and now his target is 007. Roger Moore is back as Bond, this time on a dangerous mission to recover a stolen solar invention. But The Man with the Golden Gun , the world’s most expensive assassin, is hunting him . Christopher Lee, Britt Ekland, Maud Adams, and Hervé Villechaize co-star in this globetrotting action hit filmed across Thailand, Hong Kong, Macau, and beyond.

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-3-t.description: Gypo Nolan stumbles through a foggy Irish night, his brain pickled in whiskey and his soul tormented by shame and fear. Gypo is an informer, a turncoat who betrayed his friend to the British police for 20 pounds. Now he can’t spend the money fast enough – nor can he run from his treachery fast enough – as he brawls, brags, swaggers and lies his way toward his fate. John Ford earned his first Best Director Academy Award, and star Victor McLaglen took home a Best Actor statuette for this searing four-time Oscar winner set in 1922 Dublin. Timely in its exploration of the tortured netherworld of human guilt, The Informer is filmmaking for the ages. (Warner Bros)

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-31-.description: Director Tsui Hark helms one of the most kinetic & visually striking action films to emerge from the Hong Kong golden age! A young man discovers the truth about his father’s death and embarks on quest for revenge where he loses his right arm and is left for dead. But when violence comes to his home again, he’ll have to pick up his father’s broken sword and find a new way to wield it.

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-4-m.description: The odd couple classic! Robert De Niro is a tough ex-cop tasked with finding Charles Grodin, a mild-mannered mob accountant who’s skipped bail and on the lam. But what was supposed to be a simple Midnight Run turns into a comedic, action-packed cross country chase where he’ll have to get the FBI off his case, the mob off his trail, and Grodin off his back!

The gritty and hard-hitting masterpiece features an all-time great performance from Robert De Niro and scored the Palme d’Or at the Cannes Film Festival for the director.

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-8-c.description: An anthropologist ventures to South America in search of a group who went missing while filming a documentary about cannibal tribes. And when he finds their lost footage, it will contain the shocking truth about their gruesome fate. The most controversial movie ever made has lost none of its unflinching power, a cruel cinematic landmark featuring special effects so realistic that director Ruggero Deodato was arrested on suspicion of murder.

Calling all animation aficionados! Join us for a celebration of the art and history of one of our favorite mediums with our monthly Cartoon Club! Enjoy a feature-length assemblage of classic shorts, including rare gems unearthed from the vaults and other animated antics lovingly assembled from our large archive of film treasures.

https://thenewbev.com/program/august-8-s.description: In the role he was born to play, Jack Black is Dewey Finn, a slacker guitar player still holding on to the dream of being a rock star. Due to a mix-up (and a low-level con), the wildly unqualified Dewey ends up substitute teacher in a prestigious elementary school. He recruits the bored prep school kids to form a new band, so these talented kids can rock the battle of the bands like it’s never been rocked before. This hilariously quoteable contemporary classic made Jack Black a superstar. And of course, it’s got a killer rock n rock soundtrack featuring songs from Led Zeppelin, Cream, T. Rex and the Black Keys, not to mention the original anthems performed by the kids themselves. Let’s get rockin!

https://thenewbev.com/program/july-27-ti.description: This in-name-only sequel to the first film – but peppered with much of the same cast – is an action-packed Hong Kong cop comedy. Captain Lam is nearing 40 and looking to accomplish something memorable before retiring. But first he’s gotta help find his nephew a suitable wife… while avoiding the deadly crosshairs of a dangerous smuggling ring. The Killer ’s Danny Lee headlines with martial arts superstar Conan Lee.

https://thenewbev.com/program/july-28-du.description: Meet Tip, Pam, Larry, Kit, Dusty, Sweets McGee and nameless, aimless more with young faces and old eyes. Meet them, but don’t get too attached. Because tomorrow some of them may not be alive. Most of the people who appear in his astonishing semi-documentary about the daily life of Los Angeles heroin abusers are real-life addicts, caught up in an endless cycle of stealing, hustling, jail time, shooting up, and coming down. Realistic and unapologetic, the film includes only a handful of actors, including Billy Grey ( Father Knows Best ) portraying a street-smart drug dealer. Directed by Floyd Mutrux ( American Hot Wax ), with graphic cinematography by William A. Fraker ( Bullitt ), Dusty and Sweets McGee is “a film in its own category. There are long stretches during which it’s hard to take your eyes off the screen” (Mick LaSalle, San Francisco Chronicle ). (Warner Bros)

https://thenewbev.com/program/july-31-ja.description: A stewardess, a gun runner, a bail bondsman, a federal agent, an ex-con and a stoned-out beach bunny are all on the trail of half-million dollars in Quentin Tarantino’s Jackie Brown , a mesmerizing, all-star adaptation of Elmore Leonard’s novel Rum Punch . But who’s getting played and who’s gonna make the big score?
